capabilities: Search vault notes from a right-sidebar panel with keyboard navigation
Build a local full-text index with automatic incremental updates
Retrieve results by vector embeddings using a configurable embeddings endpoint
Expand keywords, filter results, and synthesize summaries with OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini
Save AI summaries as notes to any vault folder
disambiguation: Not a locator for vault folders or files; it searches the content of notes inside the current vault.
extras: Desktop only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Sent content is limited to the query plus paths and truncated snippets of top hits, not full note bodies; with no API keys configured, indexing and search stay fully local. Settings details are deferred to the plugin settings tab rather than documented in the README.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search lacks semantic retrieval, mixed Chinese/English tokenization, and AI-assisted filtering or summarization of results.
